transcript.content: Hello, welcome. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because people keep acting like I’m making this up, but I’m not. My wife’s relative came into our house to get at me. My tools don’t just move around by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. This has been going on for months, and I can see it clearly—he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you believe that people are trying to harm you or conspire against you, even if there’s no clear evidence?

Yes. I know how it sounds, but yes. My wife’s relative has been coming at me in my own house. People keep saying I’m imagining it, but my tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. It’s been months of this, and to me it’s plain he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you ever feel like someone is putting thoughts into your mind or controlling your actions from outside?
No, I don’t think it’s like that. I don’t feel like somebody’s putting thoughts in my head or making me do things. My thoughts feel like my own.
Have you ever seen or heard things that others don't, like voices or images, even when you're alone?
No, not really. I don’t hear voices or see things like that when I’m alone. What I’m talking about is things actually happening around the house, not voices or pictures in my head.
When you notice things moving or plans being ruined, do you feel like these are normal events that have a special meaning or connection that others don’t see?

I wouldn’t call them normal events with some hidden meaning. I mean, to me it’s more direct than that. My tools don’t just move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get messed up every weekend by accident. After months of it, it’s plain to me my wife’s relative is doing it to get at me, trying to take over my place and push me out.
Even when others have shown you evidence that contradicts your belief about your wife's relative, do you still hold onto that belief without doubt?

Yes. I know what people say, that there’s no proof or that I’m reading too much into it, but I don’t buy that. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s plain to me he’s doing it—trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you believe you are being targeted or singled out because of something special or important about you, or do you think it's just a personal attack without any larger reason behind it?

I don’t think it’s because I’m some special or important person, no. It feels personal. He came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get wrecked every weekend by accident. After all this time, it’s pretty clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you believe your wife or anyone else close to you shares your belief that her relative is trying to take over your house and push you out?

No, not really. My wife and other people keep acting like I’m imagining it, like I’m making too much of it. That’s part of why I’m here. But I know what’s been going on. He came into this house to get at me—my tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, I can see plain as day he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you feel like you're being watched, followed, or spied on by the relative, or is it more about them actively trying to interfere with your life in other ways?

It’s more that he’s interfering with my life. I’m not saying he’s following me around or spying on me every minute. But he came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined by accident every weekend. After all these months, it’s clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you feel that these events happening to you are connected to something else in your life, like your worth, your failures, or things you feel guilty about?

No, I don’t think it’s about my worth or guilt or anything like that. I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I know what’s happening. My wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t keep getting spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, I can see he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Even when people have shown you that there’s no clear proof or logical explanation linking these events to your wife’s relative, do you still believe with absolute certainty that he is behind them?

Yes. I know people say there’s no proof, but I’m certain he’s behind it. I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I’m not. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s plain to me he came into this house to get at me and push me out.
Have you ever felt that your wife might be involved with her relative in a way that threatens your relationship or that she might be disloyal to you?
No, I haven’t really thought that. I don’t think it’s about my wife being disloyal or anything like that. My problem is with him and what he’s doing, not that kind of thing between them.
Even when people have explained or shown you that these things could happen by chance or for other reasons, do you still believe with complete certainty that her relative is doing this to you?

Yes. I know what people keep saying, that it could be chance or some other reason, but I don’t buy that. I’m certain it’s him. My tools don’t just move around on their own, and my fishing keeps getting messed up every weekend like that’s nothing? No. After all these months, it’s plain to me he came into this house to get at me and push me out.
